scope: Agentic Pipeline: 28 mapped acceptance tests in the authenticated A1 handoff; illustrative reviewer calibration, not a repository-wide score

specCoverage.rationale: The scoped expected test count is not a repository functionality inventory.

specQuality.rationale: No independent review of specification clauses for this report.

traceability.rationale: 28/28 mapped tests passed at the audited commit. A complete independently checked spec-to-change chain was not evaluated.

invariantCoverage.rationale: No separately reviewed invariant inventory and independent challenge suite.

domainExtraction.rationale: No sampled blind review of domain decisions and exceptions.

reconstructability.rationale: The A1 handoff audited and verified recorded tests; it did not reconstruct the implementation.

findings.observation: A1 proves scoped test traceability, not completeness of the functionality inventory.
findings.nextAction: Choose one flow and version its mandatory behavior inventory.
findings.closureCheck: An independent reviewer checks that each mandatory obligation is uniquely identified and linked to its specification.
